title: Recall: Parameterize a record and its methods
summary: Reconstruct complete expressions using the specified reference form. Formatting may vary; alternative implementations belong in Apply. Each clue states its own context because surrounding code is hidden in Recall.

consume.clue: Inside impl<T> Pair<T> for struct Pair<T> { left: T, right: T }, write the complete consuming method into_tuple returning left then right directly in a tuple.

constructor.clue: Inside impl<T> Pair<T> with fields left: T and right: T, write the complete associated function new taking those two parameters, returning Self and using field-init shorthand in left/right order.
